chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated that from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about salat al-istisqa' (the prayer for rain). He said: It is like the prayer of the two Eids.

key_terms.سَأَلْتُهُ: I asked him, introducing the legal question
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الِاسْتِسْقَاءِ: the prayer performed for seeking rain
key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: the prayer of the two Eids, used here as the legal model
key_terms.قَالَ: he said, introducing the Imam's answer

ai.seo_question: How is salat al-istisqa' performed according to Imam Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat al-istisqa' (the prayer for rain). Imam Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام states that its form is like the prayer of the two Eids, indicating that its manner is understood through the established rulings of the Eid prayer.
